original_source_statement_tex:
\label{lemma-cartier-equality}
Let $K/k$ be a finitely generated field extension.
Then $\Omega_{K/k}$ and $H_1(L_{K/k})$ are finite dimensional and
$\text{trdeg}_k(K) = \dim_K \Omega_{K/k} - \dim_K H_1(L_{K/k})$.

hypotheses: Let $K/k$ be a finitely generated field extension.
conclusions:

semantic_review_note: For finite-type field extension K/k, Ω_{K/k} and H1(L_{K/k}) are finite-dimensional and trdeg_k K = dim_K Ω - dim_K H1. Both finiteness and the negative H1 correction remain.

original_source_statement_tex:
\label{lemma-transitivity-gamma}
Let $M/L/K$ be field extensions. Then the Jacobi-Zariski
sequence
$$
0 \to H_1(L_{L/K}) \otimes_L M \to
H_1(L_{M/K}) \to
H_1(L_{M/L}) \to
\Omega_{L/K} \otimes_L M \to
\Omega_{M/K} \to
\Omega_{M/L} \to 0
$$
is exact.
statement:
Let $M/L/K$ be field extensions. Then the Jacobi-Zariski
sequence

0 \to H_1(L_{L/K}) \otimes_L M \to
H_1(L_{M/K}) \to
H_1(L_{M/L}) \to
\Omega_{L/K} \otimes_L M \to
\Omega_{M/K} \to
\Omega_{M/L} \to 0
$$
is exact.
conclusions:
the Jacobi-Zariski
sequence
$$
0 \to H_1(L_{L/K}) \otimes_L M \to
H_1(L_{M/K}) \to
H_1(L_{M/L}) \to
\Omega_{L/K} \otimes_L M \to
\Omega_{M/K} \to
\Omega_{M/L} \to 0
$$
is exact.
semantic_review_note: The field tower M/L/K has exact Jacobi–Zariski sequence 0→H1(L_{L/K})⊗_L M→H1(L_{M/K})→H1(L_{M/L})→Ω_{L/K}⊗_L M→Ω_{M/K}→Ω_{M/L}→0. The exact endpoints and ordering are retained.
